rationale: RGTI gapped up 7.8% on a $100M government contract announcement, but the news is now nearly 3 hours old and the stock has faded sharply from its $17.05 intraday high down to $16.36, placing it at just 13% of today's range and below both the 5-minute VWAP ($16.65) and the 9-EMA ($16.43) — classic gap-fade mechanics showing supply overwhelming early demand.
